item.content:encoded:
A Dog Trainer For the Humans

Helping you understand your dog, build a better bond, and create real change — No guilt, no gimmicks, no judgement, All Love.

About Me

Improving your relationship with your dog is always worth it

Hey There! I’m Joseph!

With nearly five years of experience across doggie daycare, working dog board-and-trains, and private sessions, I’ve worked with dogs of all kinds — and more importantly, the humans who care for them. Teaching dog owners the beauty and intricacies of owning and training a dog is my deepest passion!

My goal? Help you feel confident, calm, and connected with your dog. I believe in honest, empathetic coaching that empowers you to lead the dog you have to their highest potential!

I believe in finding the right methods, tools, and training for the individual. Whatever works best is what we go with! Always aiming to reduce needless suffering, the path to success, however unconventional, is always a matter of perspective!

COURSES

BASECAMP ( I)

  • Every great partnership starts with a strong foundation.

    Whether you’re welcoming a new puppy, navigating life with your first dog, or looking to get a fresh start with your canine companion, BASECAMP is where we build the skills that make everything possible. Together, we will develop clear communication, establish trust, and teach the fundamentals that create lasting change.

    This is more than dog training, it’s coaching that equips you with the knowledge and skills to confidently lead your dog long after our lessons are over.

    Perfect For: First-time owners, puppies, newly adopted dogs

RIDGELINE (II)

  • Life is better when you and your dog move through it together.

    RIDGELINE is designed for owners who are ready to move beyond the basics and create a life with their dog they can truly enjoy living. We will strengthen obedience, improve reliability, and work through any behaviors that often leave owners feeling frustrated (i.e. leash pulling, ignoring cues, overexcitement, poor impulse control, and more).

    As your coach, I will help you understand why your dog behaves the way they do and show you how to become the calm, consistent leader your dog naturally wants to follow!

    Perfect For: Dogs (and Owners) needing a refresher course, adolescent dogs (or older), and owners ready to create a well-mannered companion both at home and in the real world.

THE SUMMIT (III)

  • SUMMIT is for Owners who want a deeper relationship, greater freedom, and the confidence to handle whatever life brings with their dog. Together, we will sharpen your leadership skills, deepen your understanding of dog communication and body language, build reliability in increasingly challenging environments. and uncover your pack’s full potential!

    This is an immersive coaching experience, focusing on helping you become the kind of leader your dog can trust anywhere. For qualified teams, SUMMIT also offers specialized pathways, including my structured E-Collar Course, designed to introduce modern E-Collar communication thoughtfully, ethically, and intentionally.

    Perfect For: Graduates of RIDGELINE, experienced dog owners, and motivated teams ready to reach their full potential together.

Contact ME and BOOK YOUR FREE CONSULTATION.

  • Fill out contact information here briefly to be re-directed to our intake form! From there, we will schedule your consultation!

  • Discuss next steps

  • Unlimited guidance and support via email

  • Helpful tools, tips, and tricks for navigating your unique obstacles

Testimonials

  • “I’ve grown up with dogs all my life and have helped many overcome challenges — abused, neglected, and fearful ones. But nothing prepared me for an emaciated pit bull named Blanca.

    Blanca was about four years old when she was found running in the woods, apparently surviving on her own for quite some time. She came to me with all kinds of issues and was reactive to everything. Time and love got her part of the way, but I realized I needed to understand why she was so anxious and reactive. That’s when I decided to check my ego at the door and call in a professional.

    I cannot recommend Coach Joseph enough. He’s not only incredible with dogs — he knows how to coach you right alongside your dog. The amount of knowledge I’ve gained from working with him over six weeks is truly priceless.

    Blanca has transformed from an anxious, unpredictable pup into a dog who feels like she can talk to me. We’re so in tune now.

    I would not hesitate for a second to recommend Mountain Shack Training and Coach Joseph. Thank you for helping us find peace and understanding!”

    -Colleen & Blanca

  • Your Testimonial goes here!

  • “We cannot recommend Joseph from Mountain Shack Dog Training enough! He helped us train our mini dachshund, Honey, and he was absolutely brilliant. Dachshunds are notoriously stubborn, but Joseph taught us how to train her effectively, and she learned so quickly under his guidance.


    What really amazed us was his natural connection with animals—when he was in the house, he had every pet completely engrossed, even our cat came down just to watch! It’s clear that Joseph knows dogs inside and out and truly loves what he does. We are so grateful for his help, will definitely stay in touch, and would recommend him to anyone looking for a top-notch dog trainer.”

    -Shaun and Rose Van Staden & Honey

item.title: About
item.content:encoded:
Learning Dogs taught me how to teach humans.

About Me

Hey there! I’m Joseph Malisiak, the face and heart behind Mountainshack Dog Training. I’ve been an animal lover for as long as I can remember. Growing up, there were always dogs around—and at one point, I seriously wanted a pet bear (half-joking… mostly). As I got older (and thankfully wiser about household pet logistics), I realized working with dogs wasn’t just a passing interest—it was something I wanted to do for life.

That realization came into full focus when my wife, Ashley, and I adopted our first dog together—Lola, a sweet but complicated Newfoundland-Poodle mix. She came with separation anxiety, unpredictable energy, and a case of chronic diarrhea that no vet or food change could seem to fix. We tried it all—more exercise, more stimulation, more “maybe this will be the thing”—but nothing clicked. That is, until I stumbled into the world of dog training through a few random Instagram accounts. From that point on, I was hooked. The depth, the nuance, the psychology—I fell in love with the complexity of working with dogs, and I dove in headfirst.

My first real experience came at a doggie daycare, where I found myself managing anywhere from 15 to 30 dogs at a time. Picture me in the middle of a canine mosh pit, watching for subtle shifts in body language, breaking up disputes over toys or turf, and learning more about communication and conflict resolution than any college lecture could ever teach. Dogs handle their disagreements with clarity, calm, and boundaries—lessons I carry into my work (and let’s be honest, my own life).

After a few months, I was offered the role of in-house dog trainer. I happily accepted and began testing everything I learned on Lola, who became my living, breathing guinea pig. Once I saw real progress, I started applying those lessons to client dogs. Within six months, I was working with 70–90 clients regularly and was honored to be named Employee of the Year—driven by pure passion and an obsession with learning (and sharing) everything I could about dogs.

But I wasn’t done growing. I joined a working dog Board & Train program, where I managed the care and training of 15–20 high-drive dogs. Potty schedules, feeding, enrichment, meds, training, cleaning—you name it, I did it. I also led group classes, private lessons, and public outings to places like breweries and hardware stores. That experience was invaluable, but it also helped me realize something deeper.

No matter where I worked, there was a limit to how much freedom I had to truly advocate for the dogs and the humans behind them. There was always a company policy or PR concern standing between what I knew was right and what I was allowed to do. That tension kept growing until I finally realized—I needed to do this my own way.

So I did.

I created Mountainshack Dog Training, a company rooted in empathy, transparency, and a belief that every dog-human pair deserves support that’s tailored to them. Since starting this journey, the backbreaking parts of running a business—scheduling, accounting, web design—have somehow turned into the stuff I dance around the kitchen doing. Because when you know you’re building something that matters, the work feels a little less like work.

Meet Lola

“Soul-Dog” does not even come close with this one! Lola is my road-dog, my demo-dog, my “guinea-pig”, my partner in everything dog, and most importantly, she is my dog. She has proven to be a guiding light towards puppies and adolescents to “show them the ropes”. She acts as a mediator when other dogs get into arguments. She is a beacon of hope for any dog owners out there wondering if their dog has what it takes for greatness!

Lola’s passions are learning new behaviors to master, guarding the house from unwanted visitors, playing with her dad, and napping. She has a “best-sissy” (our cat, Gracie), and LOVES all animals with a child-like wonder. Her admiration for life and exploration brought on a wave of self-reflection that cascaded me deep into an introspective journey. Without Lola, I would not be the man, or dog trainer I am today.

item.title: FAQs
item.content:encoded:
Text/Call: (740) 816-8949 (if calling- leave a voice message)

Email: joseph@mountainshackco.com

Frequently asked questions.

🐾 What kind of training do you offer?

I offer personalized, relationship-based dog training focused on real-life results. Whether you’re dealing with obedience, reactivity, fear, aggression, or just want a better connection with your dog, I coach you through it—without gimmicks or judgment. Every plan is tailored to your dog and your lifestyle.

⸻

🐶 What types of dogs do you work with?

All kinds—young, old, happy-go-lucky, fearful, anxious, reactive, aggressive. No matter your dog’s breed or background, I’ll meet you both where you’re at and help guide you forward.

⸻

🤝 How does your approach to training work?

I coach you, the owner, just as much as I train your dog. A lot of behavioral challenges stem from misunderstandings—not “bad” dogs or “bad” owners. I focus on helping you understand your dog’s body language, motivation, and mindset, so you can build a better relationship and lasting behavior change.

⸻

📍 What areas do you serve?

I’m based in Columbus, OH, and serve Worthington, Westerville, and surrounding areas. If you’re unsure whether you’re within range, just reach out and ask!

⸻

🧠 What’s your experience?

I’ve been in the dog industry for nearly 5 years, with experience ranging from dog daycare and board-and-train facilities to freelance private training. I’ve worked with everything from service dogs to high-drive working breeds to fearful rescue dogs. I’m passionate about dog behavior, canine cognition, and helping people feel empowered, not overwhelmed.

⸻

🕒 What does a typical training session look like?

Each session runs around 60–75 minutes. We’ll work on practical exercises, talk through what you’re experiencing, and build toward sustainable progress. No cookie-cutter drills—just real guidance, tailored to you and your dog.

⸻

💬 Can I contact you with questions after a session?

Absolutely. Ongoing support between sessions is part of the coaching process. I want you to feel confident—not like you’re left hanging.

⸻

🧾 How do I get started?

Submit a response on the “Contact Me” section on the homepage, and we’ll schedule a quick consult call to make sure we’re a good fit. From there, we’ll build a plan that works for you and your dog.

⸻

💳 How do payments work?

I use Square for secure, easy payment processing—no invoices or account confusion. Payments are taken at the time of service unless otherwise arranged.

⸻

🐕 Do you offer virtual training?

Not at this time. I focus on in-person, hands-on coaching. That said, I’ll always recommend resources, give feedback, or answer questions between sessions if needed.

⸻

📝 Do you offer any guarantees?

Because dog behavior is complex and every dog-human dynamic is unique, I can’t offer guarantees—but I can promise honest work, consistent communication, and a judgment-free zone where progress is always possible.

⸻

💬 What if I want to leave a testimonial?

That would mean a lot! Just shoot me a quick message or email with a few lines about your experience. Testimonials help others know what to expect—and they help me keep doing what I love.
